environment.description: ECS Fargate service consuming from SQS queue. Messages are published by an upstream API Gateway (REST API) that accepts POST /events with a JSON body. The API Gateway has no request validation model configured — the integration passes the raw body to a Lambda that publishes to SQS. The gRPC backend service trusts metadata headers for authorization decisions (x-auth-context, x-tenant-id, authorization).

config.api_gateway: REST API, no request validator, proxy integration to Lambda publisher
config.sqs_queue: Standard queue, no message filtering or content-based deduplication
config.grpc_backend: Trusts x-auth-context and x-tenant-id metadata for authz decisions
config.network: All services in same VPC, no service mesh or mTLS between consumer and gRPC backend
